description: Source code for handling Open vSwitch (OVS) basic types with JSON serialization/deserialization, including optional and required types for integers, booleans, doubles, strings, and UUIDs, with focus on OVS-specific set representations.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_basic_q_from_json
methods.description: Converts optional JSON value to an OVS basic type, handling empty sets for non-existence.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_basic_from_json
methods.description: Converts required JSON value to a C type, with workaround for non-existent objects.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_basic_q_to_json
methods.description: Converts optional OVS basic type to JSON, representing presence with set length.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_basic_to_json
methods.description: Converts required OVS basic type to JSON, always with set length 1.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_int_q_to_json
methods.description: Serializes C int (optional) to JSON.

methods.name: pjs_ovs_int_to_json
methods.description: Serializes C int (required) to JSON.

methods.description: Serializes C bool (required) to JSON.
